title: SAPO: Step-Aligned Policy Optimization for Reasoning-Based Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2605.17648v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative recommendation treats next-item prediction as autoregressive item-identifier generation. Specifically, items are encoded as semantic identifiers (SIDs), which are short coarse-to-fine token sequences whose early tokens capture broad semantics and later tokens refine them. Recent work augments this paradigm with reasoning traces and optimizes them via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, typically outcome-reward algorithm with exact-match feedback on the generated SID. However, in large-catalog recommendation, exact-match feedback on the generated SID only reports whether the final item is correct; when a generated SID mismatches, outcome-reward cannot identify which SID-token prediction caused the mismatch and may penalize matched SID-token positions together with the mismatched position. We identify that the natural unit of credit assignment in this setting is a single reasoning step (one thinking block paired

translated_title: 步骤对齐策略优化：用于基于推理的生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐将下一项预测视为自回归的项标识符生成。具体来说，项被编码为语义标识符（SIDs），这些是简短的从粗到细的标记序列，其早期标记捕获广泛语义，后续标记则细化它们。近期工作通过推理轨迹增强此范式，并使用可验证奖励的强化学习进行优化，通常采用基于结果奖励的算法，对生成的SID进行精确匹配反馈。然而，在大规模目录推荐中，对生成的SID的精确匹配反馈仅报告最终项是否正确；当生成的SID不匹配时，结果奖励无法识别哪个SID标记预测导致了不匹配，并可能将匹配的SID标记位置与不匹配位置一同惩罚。我们识别出在此设置中，信用分配的自然单位是单个推理步骤（一个思考块配对）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种步骤对齐策略优化方法，通过将信用分配细化为单个推理步骤，解决了生成式推荐中结果奖励无法定位SID标记预测错误的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a step-aligned policy optimization method that refines credit assignment to individual reasoning steps, addressing the issue where outcome rewards fail to locate SID token prediction errors in generative recommendation.
